source.sqlReaderQuery: select LastLoadTime from dbo.ADF_Watermark where TableName = 'Employee';

sqlReaderQuery.value:
@concat(
'SELECT EmployeeID, EmployeeName, Department, Salary, LastModifiedDate
 FROM dbo.Employee
 WHERE LastModifiedDate > ''',
activity('Lookup_Old_Watermark').output.firstRow.LastLoadTime,
''' AND LastModifiedDate <= ''',
activity('Lookup_New_Watermark').output.firstRow.NewWatermark,
''''
)

source.sqlReaderQuery:
SELECT
    COALESCE
    (
        MAX(LastModifiedDate),
        CAST('1900-01-01' AS DATETIME2)
    ) AS NewWatermark
FROM Employee;
